claim: A sprite that changes sector by passing through a room-over-room link (water, stack) does not fire the destination sector's Enter trigger: Enter and Exit are tested before the link is checked, and the next tick already finds the sprite in its new sector. A secret or trigger sector reached only through a link never fires.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/actor.cpp:4552-4572 Exit/Enter (kCmdSectorEnter) on an ordinary sector change, then actor.cpp:4644 CheckLink moves the sprite with no Enter
noted in projects/blood-city/level/underwater.py (the flooded branch's secret is the dry bank beyond the dive)
use: Put a secret or a trigger on a sector the player walks into after the link (the bank, the landing), never on the linked sector itself.
